body: The two code snippets together are the smallest scenario I could find that (in our environment)  shows the issue.

I'm experiencing this issue as well.

I created a [repo that reproduces this issue](https://github.com/kmckee/action-issue-repro).  

Steps taken to create it are:

1. `npx create-react-app foo && cd foo`
2. `npx sb init`
3. `npm run storybook` and confirm that button actions are getting logged.
3. In `Button.js`, [change defaultProp of onClick to empty function](https://github.com/kmckee/action-issue-repro/commit/f5f2920bfc0d74f237575294d679ab24767df68c).
4. actions are no longer logged.
